response.original_title: Uns e Outros, Os Chineses de Macau
response.overview: Much like the other episodes of *Macau, 20 Years Later*, this installment seeks to construct a panoramic view of *Portugalidade* (Portuguese identity) and the *Lusofonia* (the Portuguese-speaking world) within contemporary Macanese society. However, according to the series’ production notes, the unique aspect of this final episode lies in its aim to “capture perspectives, opinions, and sentiments regarding the presence of the Portuguese and the *Lusofonia* in Macau—viewed from an ‘other’ side—and to integrate this dimension, along with how it interprets us. And, since one group cannot exist without the other, the episode also documents the voices and faces of the community that is dominant and constitutes the majority in Macau: the Chinese.”
response.title: Uns e Outros, Os Chineses de Macau
